{{Short description|English-Canadian biologist (born 1933)}}
'''Bryce Kendrick''' (born 1933) is an English-Canadian [[biologist]], who spent the majority of his career in [[Canada]], principally at the [[University of Waterloo]] in Ontario.

==Biography==
Kendrick was born in [[Liverpool]] in 1933. After completing his bachelor's degree (1955) and Ph.D. (1958) at the [[University of Liverpool]], he took an assignment as a postdoctoral fellow with the Plant Research Institute of [[Agriculture and Agri-Food Canada|Agriculture Canada]] in [[Ottawa]], [[Canada]], remaining there as a research officer until 1965, when he accepted a position as assistant professor in the biology department at the [[University of Waterloo]] in [[Ontario]]. The following year he became as associate professor, and in 1971 he was made a full professor. He received his D.Sc. from the University of Liverpool in 1980.<ref>[https://www.mycolog.com/bryce.html Biography page at mycolog.com]</ref> From 1985 he was Waterloo's associate dean for graduate affairs. Kendrick retired from the University of Waterloo and received a distinguished professor emeritus in 1994.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.biology.uwaterloo.ca/people/adjunct.html |title=Adjunct Faculty U of W |access-date=2008-06-28 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090827002339/http://www.biology.uwaterloo.ca/people/adjunct.html |archive-date=2009-08-27 |url-status=dead }}</ref> He moved to [[Sidney, British Columbia]], maintaining adjunct professorships at both the University of Waterloo and [[University of Victoria]]. He continues to consult and publish in his field; since 2004 he has been the technical advisor for Aerobiology Laboratory Associates in [[Reston, Virginia]].

Kendrick wrote several books,<ref>[http://www.worldcat.org/search?q=au%3ABryce+Kendrick&qt=hot_author Biblio Search on Worldcat.org]</ref> and over 300 publications,<ref>[http://www.mycolog.com/CV%20Apr08.htm#publications Bryce Kendrick's full CV including list of publications] {{webarchive |url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080703222027/http://www.mycolog.com/CV%20Apr08.htm#publications |date=July 3, 2008 }}</ref> including a textbook about [[fungi]], ''The Fifth Kingdom''.<ref>[https://www.mycolog.com/fifthrev.html The Fifth Kingdom on CD reviews]</ref>

== Honours ==
* U.K. Science Council Senior Visiting Scholarship 1974
* [[Guggenheim Fellowship]] 1979<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.gf.org/79fellow.html |title=List of Guggenheim Fellowships awarded in 1979 |access-date=2008-06-27 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080516060720/http://www.gf.org/79fellow.html |archive-date=2008-05-16 |url-status=dead }}</ref>
* Distinguished Visiting Scholar, [[University of Adelaide]] 1979
* Fellow of the [[Royal Society of Canada]] 1981<ref>RSC: The Academies of Arts, Humanities and Sciences of Canada [http://www.rsc.ca/index.php?page_id=96&lang_id=1&first_name=bryce&last_name=kendrick&academy=&institute_name=&year_election=&submit=Search RSC Member Search].</ref>
* Distinguished Research Fellow, Foundation for Research Development, South Africa 1990
* Visiting Fellow, Foundation for Research Development, South Africa. 1992
* Sir. C.V. Raman Visiting Professorship, [[University of Madras]]. 1993
* Hon. Secretary, Academy of Science, [[Royal Society of Canada]] 1985–1991
* Distinguished Professor Emeritus, [[University of Waterloo]] 1995
* Distinguished Mycologist Award,<ref>[http://msafungi.org/msa-awards/distinguished-mycologist-award/ 1996 Distinguished Mycologist Reward] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20131103072317/http://msafungi.org/msa-awards/distinguished-mycologist-award/ |date=2013-11-03 }}</ref> [[Mycological Society of America]] 1996
* Centenary Fellow,<ref>[http://www.bms.ac.uk/XMYbms.html] BMS News vol 8-13</ref> [[British Mycological Society]] 1996
* Lawson Medal [http://www.cba-abc.ca/lawson.htm] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080211093648/http://www.cba-abc.ca/lawson.htm |date=2008-02-11 }}, [[Canadian Botanical Association]] 2001<ref>[http://www.cba-abc.ca/AwardRes.htm Past Recipients of the Lawson Medal]</ref><ref>[https://www.ou.edu/cas/botany-micro/ben/ben274.html Text from Awards Ceremony]</ref>
